findings.message: The canonical names a different URL, so this page asks search engines to index that URL instead. Confirm this is intended.
findings.evidence: canonical https://aquarythu.com vs page https://aquarythu.com/about (a trailing slash difference alone is tolerated)

findings.message: The title is shorter than 30 characters. A very short title rarely describes the page well enough to earn a click. This is a heuristic, not a search engine rule.
Some images have no width and height attributes, which lets the layout shift while they load.
Heading levels skip inside the main content, for example from H2 to H4. Google Search does not mind heading order, but screen reader users move through a page by heading level.
findings.evidence: 1 skipped heading level(s) in the main content

findings.message: The page has no og:image, so shared links show no preview image.
findings.evidence: og:title is present, og:image is not
